overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: colPosition
params.description: Position the new column is inserted in front of; if greater than the total number of columns, the column is added last.

params.name: colName
params.description: Name of the new column object.

params.name: colVariable
params.description: For an array-type list box, the array (matching name required) to display in the column; for a selection list box, the field or variable evaluated per record; a Nil pointer is allowed in a dynamic context.

contentParam.name: headerName
contentParam.description: Name of the column header object.

bindingParam.name: headerVar
bindingParam.description: Column header variable (or a Nil pointer ->[] in a dynamic context).

params.description: Names and binds the inserted column's header object/variable.
Optional: names and binds the inserted column's footer object/variable.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Inserts a new column, with its header and optional footer, into the designated list box; does nothing on the first column of a hierarchical-mode list box.

constraints: With a selection list box, colVariable must be a field or variable (not an array), and this content type requires the list box's Data Source to be Current Selection or Named Selection.
Does nothing if applied to the first column of a list box displayed in hierarchical mode.
